Legal

Privacy policy.

Last updated: 27 October 2026

Shan Graphics Designer ("we", "us") respects your privacy. This page explains what happens to your information when you use this website.

Information we collect

This website does not use accounts, cookies for tracking, analytics or advertising tools, and it does not store your data on any server. The only information we receive is what you choose to send us: your name, email, the service you need and your project details when you use the enquiry form, call us, message us on WhatsApp or email us.

How the enquiry form works

When you press "Send message", the form opens your own email app with your message filled in. Nothing is sent until you press send there. We use your details only to reply to your enquiry and to carry out the work you ask for.

Third-party services

Fonts, images and video are served from this website itself. Links to Instagram and WhatsApp open those services, which have their own privacy policies. We do not control them.

Sharing and storage

We do not sell or rent your information. We share it only if the law requires. Emails and messages you send us are kept only as long as needed to handle your enquiry and project.

Your choices

You can ask us to delete the messages or files you sent us, or to correct your details, at any time.

Children

This website is not meant for children under 13, and we do not knowingly collect their information.

Changes

We may update this policy. The date above shows the latest version.
